content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Schedule Emails with SendGrid ## slug: msg-ss-schedule-emails-sendgrid ## seoTitle: Schedule Emails with SendGrid ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Use {{variable.Feature_SendGrid}} from the {{variable.Product_Events}} app to send scheduled emails that are created using the {{variable.Component_SmartScheduler}}. For information about setting up {{variable.Feature_SendGrid}}, please click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/enhanced-emails){target=`_blank`}. ## Pre-requisites If you haven’t already set up {{variable.Component_SmartScheduler}}, please complete the tasks on the following pages. 1. [Upgrade the Messaging App](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-upgrade-messaging-app){target=`_blank`} 2. [Upgrade the Blackthorn Base, Payments, and Events Apps](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-upgrade-base-payments-events-apps){target=`_blank`} 3. [Assign New Permission Sets](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-assign-new-permission-sets){target=`_blank`} 4. [Create an Org-wide Email Address](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-create-org-wide-email-address){target=`_blank`} 6. [Activate the Smart Scheduler's Feature Toggle](/v1/docs/msg-ss-activate-smart-scheduler-component){target=`_blank`} 7. [Start Here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-configure-messaging-scheduler-component){target=`_blank`} 8. [Register Your Account](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-register-your-account){target=`_blank`} 9. [Authenticate a User](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-authenticate-user){target=`_blank`} 10. [Add the BT Event Scheduler Component to the Event Record](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-add-event-scheduler-component-event-record){target=`_blank`} ## Add the SendGrid API Key in the BT Base App 1. Open the Events (Admin) app. 2. Click the Smart Scheduler Admin tab. (If you don’t see the tab, click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/ev-ss-configure-event-scheduler-component){target=`_blank`} to review the steps.) 3. Click **Add API Key**. 4. Enter the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_SendGridAPIKey}}. 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![SendGrid API Key](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/SendGrid%20API%20Key.png){height="" width=""} Once the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_SendGridAPIKey}} is available in the {{variable.Product_Events}} app, you can retrieve it from the Smart Scheduler Admin tab by clicking **Retrieve From Event App** and use it in the BT Base app. ![Retrieve From Events App](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Retrieve%20From%20Events%20App.png){height="" width=""} ## Settings ### Turn On/Off the SendGrid Feature You can turn on/off the feature that allows users to schedule {{variable.Feature_SendGrid}} emails from the BT Base app. 1. Open to the Events (Admin) app. 2. Click the Smart Scheduler Admin tab. 3. Click the Configuration Settings tab. 4. Toggle the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AllwSchCrSendG}} setting on or off. 5. Click **Update Setting**. ![Schedule Settings](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Schedule%20Settings.png){height="" width=""} ### Set Email Notifications You can select {{variable.Feature_SendGrid}} for email notifications from the Email Notification Settings on the Smart Scheduler Admin tab. 1. Open to the Events (Admin) app. 2. Click the Smart Scheduler Admin tab. 3. Click the Configuration Settings tab. 4. Set {{variable.Field_SmartSche_PlatforEmaNoti}} to “SendGrid.” 5. Select an email address in the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_FromEmailAddre}} field. 6. Click **Update Settings**. ![Set Email Notifications](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Set%20Email%20Notifications.png){height="" width=""} ### Functionality * {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AllwSchCrSendG}} can only be toggled on/off if the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_SendGridAPIKey}} field contains a value. * The {{variable.Field_SmartSche_SendGridAPIKey}} must be added to the BT Base Admin app before users can select "SendGrid" in the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_PlatforEmaNoti}} field. * Users cannot remove/modify the API Key if the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AllwSchCrSendG}} setting is toggled "ON." * Users cannot remove/modify the API Key if there is an active email scheduled job with {{variable.Feature_SendGrid}} selected as the from email. * Users cannot remove/modify the API Key when {{variable.Feature_SendGrid}} is selected as the platform for email notification in the Email Notification Settings. ## Schedule SendGrid Emails Use the {{variable.Component_SmartScheduler}} to schedule {{variable.Feature_SendGrid}} emails. 1. Make sure {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AllwSchCrSendG}} is set to “On.” 2. Open the relevant {{variable.Object_Event}} record. 3. Click the Communications tab. (If you don’t see the Communications tab, click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/msg-ss-add-event-scheduler-component-event-record){target=`_blank`} to learn how to add it.) 4. Click **New Message**. ### Recipients Section 1. Select Schedule “an Email.” 2. Select “Event Attendees” or “Session Attendees.” 3. Enter a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_ScheduleName}}. 4. Select “SendGrid.” ![Salesforce or SendGrid](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Salesforce%20or%20SendGrid.png){height="" width=""} 6. Select a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_FromEmailAddre}}. 7. Select a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_ToEmail}}. 8. Choose an {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AttendeeFilter}}. * If you set {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AttendeeFilter}} = “Attendance Status”, select the relevant options in the {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendancStatus}} field. * If you set {{variable.Field_SmartSche_AttendeeFilter}} = “Registration Status”, select the relevant options in the {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} field. 9. There must be at least one recipient listed in {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}}. 10. If a zero is listed under {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}}, check that you have the correct status selected and review the Attendees that should have the chosen status. 11. Confirm that the amount under {{variable.Field_SmartSche_EmailBalance}} is greater than the number of {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}}. 12. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. ### Schedule Section 1. Choose one of the three options below to schedule your email. * Send the email at a specific date and time * Choose the specific date and time in the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_SelectDateTime}} fields. * Send the email X Minutes/Hours/Days After/Before the selected trigger. * Enter the number. * Choose “Days”, “Hours”, or “Minutes”. * Select “Before” or “After”. * Choose “Event Start Date/Time”, Event End Date/Time”, “Event Attendee Registration Date”, or “Event Attendee Created Date”. * Select {{variable.Field_SmartSche_Now}} to send the email two minutes after the email is scheduled. 2. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. ### Message Section 1. In the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EmailTemplate}} field, search for an existing {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} or click {{variable.Button_CreateNew}} to create a new one. 2. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. ### Send Test Section 1. Enter a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TestEmail}}. Make sure to use an email that can be checked easily. Using your email is a good option. 2. Select a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TestRecord}}. 3. Click **Send Test**. 4. After you receive the success message, click **Schedule**.
